There are 8 gRPC/Connect services defined under `proto/api/v1/`: AIService (`proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto`), AttachmentService (`proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto`), AuthService (`proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto`), IdentityProviderService (`proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto`), InstanceService (`proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto`), MemoService (`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`), ShortcutService (`proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`), and UserService (`proto/api/v1/user_service.proto`).
